source.title: Belfast Newsletter, 8 June 1964, p. 9 ("Hillsborough Rural District Council: notice of result of elections, 1964"); Belfast News-Letter, 5 June 1964, p. 2 ("Hillsborough Labour man polls 17 votes")
source.publisher: Belfast Newsletter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names and votes read on the page images of the notice (8 June 1964, p. 9) and the report of 5 June 1964, p. 2: Campbell 301, Harron (Lab.) 17 (council-audit, Nov 2026).

note: Triennial election of Hillsborough Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Hillsborough, Maze and Anahilt were contested and the other thirteen divisions were returned unopposed. The result report prints the Labour candidate as Robert Herron; the nomination report of 20 May printed the Anahilt Labour nominee as Robert Marron. Addresses and occupations printed with the names are not reproduced (privacy rule; gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).
correctionNote: Corrected from the page images of the Belfast News-Letter, 8 June 1964, p. 9 and 5 June 1964, p. 2 (council-audit, Nov 2026): the defeated candidate's surname is Harron in both (was entered as Herron); his Labour label and the 61.87 per cent poll added from the 5 June report.
